answer_1.quote: Our approach, in contrast, models suspense using general language models fine-tuned on stories, without planning and domain knowledge.
answer_1.outputs: The model computes suspense measures such as surprise and uncertainty reduction over story continuations, which can be used to predict turning points in narratives.

answer_2.quote: We use Spearman's ρ (Sen, 1968) and Kendall's τ to compare model predictions and absolute suspense values.

answer_4.quote: five master workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk annotated each story after reading instructions and completing a training phase.
answer_4.guideline: Judge each sentence on how the dramatic tension has changed as felt by the main characters in the story, not what you as a reader feel. Dramatic tension is the excitement or anxiousness over what will happen to the characters next, it is anticipation. Increasing levels of each of the following increase the level of dramatic tension: • Uncertainty: How uncertain are the characters involved about what will happen next? • Significance: How significant are the consequences of what will happen to the central characters of the story?
